# My Editing and Proofreading Desk

> Institutional human editing, proofreading, document formatting, and translation review for academic researchers, PhD/Master's candidates, peer-reviewed journal authors, legal scholars, and corporate teams worldwide.

## Institutional Overview & Subject-Matter Desks
My Editing and Proofreading Desk (https://www.editandproofread.com) provides 100% human-led editorial review delivered with timestamped Microsoft Word Track Changes and margin rationale comments. Projects are routed across four specialized institutional review desks:
1. **STEM & Clinical Medicine Desk**: IMRaD manuscript structure, statistical reporting clarity (p-values, confidence intervals), CONSORT/PRISMA/STROBE alignment, and LaTeX/Word mathematical equations (AMA 11th, IEEE, Vancouver, CSE, Nature/Elsevier/Springer).
2. **Social Sciences, Education & Humanities Desk**: Qualitative rigor, theoretical framing, participant quote lock, and cross-chapter thesis cohesion (APA 7th, Chicago 17th, MLA 9th, Harvard).
3. **Law, Policy & Jurisprudence Desk**: Statutory interpretation clarity, comparative legal analysis, and pinpoint footnote integrity (OSCOLA 4th, The Bluebook 21st, AGLC4, McGill Guide).
4. **Corporate, Executive & Regulatory Desk**: Whitepapers, R&D grant proposals (NIH, NSF, Horizon Europe, UKRI), policy briefs, and institutional compliance (AP, Economist, EC Interinstitutional Style Guide).

## Pricing Calculator Rules & Rate Structure
- **Standard Base Rate**: `$0.030` per word for Proofreading, Substantive Editing, Academic Editing, and Business Editing.
- **Unified Academic Rate Policy**: Proofreading (final surface check: grammar, typos, punctuation, formatting consistency) and Editing (deep sentence mechanics, structural flow, academic tone, hedging, and argument clarity) share the same per-word rate curve so researchers never under-select surface proofreading when their manuscript needs substantive editing.
- **Turnaround Rate Scaling**: Effective rates scale from `$0.022` to `$0.038` per word based on selected turnaround speed (`12 hours`, `24 hours`, `48 hours`, `3 days`, `5 days`, `7 days`, `14 days`, `28 days / 4 weeks`).
- **3,500-Word Baseline Example**: At the 14-day turnaround pace, the effective rate is `$0.023` per word (`3,500 words × $0.023 = $80.50` editorial subtotal; with the standard `5%` checkout processing fee of `$4.03`, the final verified total is `$84.53`).
- **Specialty Service Rates**:
  - **Document Formatting**: `$0.040` per word base rate (`$0.029–$0.051/word` across turnaround tiers).
  - **Translation Review**: `$0.055` per word base rate.
  - **Transcribing**: `$0.026` per word base rate.
  - **Writing Support**: `$450.00` fixed service package.
- **Order Thresholds**: `$10.00` minimum order; automatic calculator estimates apply up to `50,000` words. Manuscripts above `50,000` words receive a custom timeline and quote.
- **Free Trials & Lead Magnets**:
  - **Free 300-Word Human Sample Edit**: Researchers with confidential, unpublished theses or manuscripts can request a complimentary 300-word human sample edit at https://www.editandproofread.com/contact?type=sample-edit or https://www.editandproofread.com/submit?sample=true.
  - **Free 1,000-Word AI First-Pass Tool**: Browser-based grammar and clarity assistant capped at 1,000 words at https://www.editandproofread.com/ai-editing-tool.

## Academic Integrity & Ethics Boundaries
- **100% Human Authorship Preservation**: Editors refine clarity, syntax, scholarly register, hedging, and formatting while preserving the author's original intellectual contribution and voice.
- **Zero Ghostwriting or Fabrication**: We never invent data, citations, statistical outcomes, or write assessed academic chapters on behalf of students.
- **COPE & University Ethics Alignment**: Every edit is delivered via transparent, timestamped MS Word Track Changes (`All Markup`) plus clean copy, providing an auditable revision trail that protects student and researcher authorship against synthetic-voice desk rejections and false-positive AI flags.
- **Strict Confidentiality**: Private encrypted portal uploads; client manuscripts are never used to train external LLMs.
